holds.description: New or changed product behavior: anything a CMS user, API client or admin user can observe. Satisfied by an approved spec revision that covers the change, or by the owner.
Reverses a deliberate earlier decision. Read `git log -S` for the lines the change touches; a commit that chose the current behavior on purpose makes this hold apply.
Deletes infrastructure the owner still builds on: scripts, workflows, harness tests, packages, compose services or fixtures in use.
Spending money, schedules, cost caps, or a lowered threshold such as coverage or mutation scores.
Public documentation beyond development setup. AGENTS.md authorizes routine README.md setup updates that reflect agreed tooling changes; the owner decides the rest.
Workflow and automation changes: GitHub Actions workflows, the shared setup action, Dependabot and git hooks.
Relaxes or deletes an existing test, assertion, lint rule, policy rule, coverage threshold or harness check. Adding a guardrail does not trip this hold.
Touches a path in .github/CODEOWNERS: automation, agent instructions, auth, migrations, public documentation, the license and .factory/. GitHub requires the owner's code-owner review on these paths.
Changes the factory policy or the repository contract it relies on: .factory/, the rulesets and CODEOWNERS. The PR is evaluated with the policy at its base.

Tooling, CI or dependencies: package manifests, the lockfile, runtime versions, build, lint, type-check and test configuration, and repository scripts. Requires the independent security lens: credential exposure, new network access, code that runs during install or CI, and weakened checks.

mandatory: affected tests selected and passing, with the command and exit code
vp run check exit 0 on the final commit
observable outcomes and failure cases written before implementation
tests written first and seen failing for the intended reason
tests exercise Aircastle code through the module's public interface
optional: focused fault check of test sensitivity

mandatory: component tests beside the feature through its public entry point (apps/web/VERIFICATION.md)
a browser journey in apps/web/e2e for the changed user path when correctness depends on real entry, CSS, browser storage or history, focus, keyboard input or integration between features
relevant failure cases selected, or stated as not applicable: invalid or empty data, long and Unicode text, large lists, narrow screens, text enlargement, persistence, loading and network errors
optional: recorded journeys from vp run test-web:record in the PR body
coverage from vp run test-web:coverage with raw covered and total counts

mandatory: property tests for changed validation or compilation rules
schema coverage at or above the thresholds in packages/schema/vite.config.ts (vp run test:coverage)
type fixtures for changed public types (vp run test:typecheck)
optional: mutation run: vp -C packages/schema run test:mutation

mandatory: route tests through createApp
database-backed tests run with vp run db:test -- <command>
the ContentStore contract suite on the fake store and on Postgres
database-dependent guarantees such as uniqueness enforced at the persistence layer
a planted violation fails the check, with the command and exit code, and is removed
hurried-agent bypasses tried and closed or explained
the guardrails table in .agents/skills/guardrails/SKILL.md updated
vp run lint:workflows exit 0
tests/harness/ci-parity.test.ts passes
measured critical path: wall-clock time of the slowest job chain before and after, from CI runs
vp run check exit 0 on the final commit
no new install-time or CI-time code execution without a stated reason
factory validate exit 0 for the PR head
tests/harness/factory-policy.test.ts passes
every vp run recipe names a real script (tests/harness/command-recipes.test.ts)
every relative link resolves
the rubric's communication standard
